title: Anti AI bingo
author: KingofKingsofKingsof
selftext:
How do you deal with the 'anti AI' crowd? Is It worth replying to the 'Ai slop' comments or just ignore them? It is frustrating to go from 'looks great!' 'plays really well', 'Really fun' to 'AI slop!' when you tell them how it is created? Like, please create something better! No?  

I don't want to hide what I've done, I'm proud of what I've achieved, and god knows my wife has had to put up with how much time I've put into it.  

Rant over. Let's play some bingo:

  
'Gen AI slop' - really? A minute ago it was 'looks great' etc. Pick a lane.

'Stop making excuses' - I'm not. I've got a full time job, other hobbies and a life. I'm not going to spend years recreating something AI can do in minutes just to make you feel better about yourself.

'You couldn't have done that without AI' - no shit, Sherlock. That's exactly the point. You might as well tell Archimedes "You can't move the world without that lever."

'You stole X' - from who? Then arrest me.

'learn to code' - I can code to an extent,  but again see above and levers. I don't need to. Just like I don't need to press my own olives or refine my own gas.

'hire an artist' - let me check my magic money tree for £50,000. Hmmm. Nope, nothing here. If anyone wants  to collaborate for a share of profits then that's different, but for a part time, solo hobbyist to suddenly fund a full time artist for what will likely be a free game or commercial failure, it's laughable and naive.
